baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَ at word 2 and تَوَلَّىٰ at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first verb assigns falsehood to a claim, and the coordinated second verb converts that verdict into withdrawal of attention and compliance. The ayah presents a speech-act-to-posture sequence.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something or someone false supplies the active verdict rather than mere uncertainty.
Turning back and refusing attention supplies the enacted withdrawal that follows the verdict.

changed_reading.before: He did not believe and left.
changed_reading.after: He actively pronounces the claim false and then embodies that verdict by withdrawing attention and compliance.

baseline_models.mechanism: The charge toward a required response proves false by not being carried through, while succession in the second root makes withdrawal the immediate continuation of that failure.

activation_trace.role: A charge that fails to carry through supplies a performative, not merely propositional, failure.
Unbroken succession makes turning away the next stage of the failed response.

changed_reading.after: He makes the demanded response fail in performance, with withdrawal following as its uninterrupted completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's lying-soul image meets a context in which the self contains awareness and reproach. Denial and turning can therefore be carried as an internal conflict in which one self-position evades another that keeps blaming it.

activation_trace.role: The branch naming the soul as al-kadhub anchors denial inside the subject rather than only between speaker and report.
Withdrawal supplies the evasion of an inwardly present demand.
The self as inner reason and awareness supplies an internal witness capable of contesting denial.
Deserved blame supplies the reproaching pressure from which the focus subject turns.

structural_cues: 75:2 joins the self directly to intensive reproach, and 75:14 later returns to self-directed perception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lying-soul branch, inner awareness, and deserved blame; I infer that these can coexist as competing positions within the focus subject. A live alternative is that the reproaching self names a distinct eschatological state rather than a presently resisted faculty.

changed_reading.before: The subject rejects an external claim and turns away from it.
changed_reading.after: The subject's denying self also turns away from an internal, reproaching awareness that remains active.

context_deltas.mechanism: Desire precedes a breach projected ahead. Calling the claim false and withdrawing compliance becomes an enabling operation: it clears the subject's forward path for continued transgression.

activation_trace.role: An active falsehood verdict supplies the justificatory move that removes the claim's authority.
Refusal of attention and compliance supplies the practical release from restraint.
Will and desire supply the motive that precedes the rejecting acts.
Deviation from truth and breach of a boundary supply the conduct that denial makes easier.
What lies ahead supplies the prospective horizon toward which the desire is directed.

structural_cues: 75:5 grammatically places wanting before transgressing ahead, making appetite rather than lack of evidence the stated driver.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, boundary-breach, and a forward horizon; I infer the arrow from denial to permission for future conduct. A live alternative is that 75:5 describes a general human tendency without specifying the individual in 75:32.

changed_reading.before: He rejects because he judges the claim untrue.
changed_reading.after: He judges it untrue in order to keep the road ahead open for conduct that its truth would constrain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spatial force of turning away is tested against a sequence that asks for escape, removes refuge, and fixes the final station at the Lord. The withdrawal is movement, but not successful departure.

activation_trace.role: Retreat and turning back supply the attempted spatial exit in the focus.
Flight and escape make the latent destination of the focus withdrawal explicit.
Refuge supplies the destination that the context immediately negates.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the authority from whom no turn can exit.
Fixed settlement closes the spatial mechanism by assigning an unavoidable endpoint.

structural_cues: 75:10-12 moves in three steps from the question of escape, to no refuge, to a fixed destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retreat, flight, absent refuge, sovereignty, and settlement; I infer that the focus turn is an attempted escape whose path is already enclosed. A live alternative is that تَوَلَّىٰ is solely ethical refusal and carries no spatial coloring here.

changed_reading.before: He turns away and thereby leaves the encounter.
changed_reading.after: He performs an attempted escape, but every possible turn remains inside a route ending at the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self possesses inward perception before excuses are cast outward. The focus denial is therefore sharpened from possible ignorance into a defensive counter-verdict against knowledge carried by the subject himself.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the claim false supplies the outward counter-verdict.
Refusing attention supplies avoidance once the inward witness becomes inconvenient.
Reason and awareness within the self supply the location of counter-knowledge.
Insight of the heart supplies perception that does not depend on the public denial.
Casting something outward supplies the defensive presentation of excuses.
Excuse and exculpation supply the cover that cannot erase self-perception.

structural_cues: 75:14 asserts self-directed perception; 75:15 concedes the subsequent production of excuses without allowing them to displace it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward awareness followed by cast excuses; I infer that the later falsehood verdict functions defensively against that awareness. A live alternative is that the self-witness appears only at judgment and need not imply prior conscious recognition.

changed_reading.before: His denial may report what he sincerely thinks.
changed_reading.after: His denial reads as an outward defense against a self that already sees enough to testify against him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context lays out an ordered reception process: do not rush, receive the recitation, follow it, then allow clarification. Against that sequence, كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ can be heard as premature classification followed by refusal to remain through explanation.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report false supplies the premature classification at issue.
Refusal of attention and compliance breaks the reception sequence.
Haste supplies the temporal error of deciding before the process is complete.
Recitation supplies the message as an unfolding act that must first be received.
Following in sequence supplies the response that turning away interrupts.
Disclosure of meaning supplies the explanatory stage abandoned by a rushed verdict.

structural_cues: 75:16-19 is a tightly ordered four-ayah sequence of restraint, recitation, following, and explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reception sequence and the focus supplies verdict plus withdrawal; I infer that the latter can invert the former as a failed listening process. A live alternative is that 75:16-19 addresses a different hearer and should not be transferred psychologically to the rejecter.

changed_reading.before: He reaches a settled judgment and then leaves.
changed_reading.after: He rushes to classify the message as false and exits the process before following and clarification can do their work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Love fastens the heart to the immediate while the later is left behind. The focus pair becomes an allegiance transfer: the claim is falsified so that attention and loyalty can remain with what arrives quickly.

activation_trace.role: The falsehood verdict removes the competing claim of the later horizon.
Loyal affiliation supplies the positive attachment hidden inside an apparent turning away.
Withdrawal supplies the corresponding abandonment of the rival horizon.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the adhesive force of the preferred allegiance.
Speed and precedence supply the immediate horizon preferred by the subject.
Leaving a thing supplies the active abandonment paired with love of the immediate.
What comes after supplies the displaced temporal horizon.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 forms an explicit antithesis: loving the immediate is coordinated with leaving the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-attachment, immediacy, abandonment, and laterness; I infer that the focus denial protects one temporal allegiance by disqualifying another. A live alternative is that the pair describes communal preference broadly rather than this subject's immediate motive.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is pure negation with no indicated destination.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is the negative side of a positive allegiance to immediacy: he abandons the later because his heart remains attached to the quick.

context_deltas.mechanism: Voluntary withdrawal loses its agency as separation arrives, the body folds upon itself, and the subject is driven to the Lord. The context reverses the directionality of تَوَلَّىٰ: one may choose to turn, but not choose the final conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary retreat supplies the initial directional agency that the context overturns.
Separation and distancing supply the irreversible break that ends ordinary agency.
One thing wrapping upon another supplies the body's constriction at the transfer point.
Driving and herding supply compelled motion in place of the subject's chosen turn.
Sovereign lordship supplies the destination and controller of the final movement.

structural_cues: 75:28-30 compresses realization of separation, bodily entanglement, and final conveyance into one directional sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary retreat in the focus and separation, bodily wrapping, driving, and lordship in context; I infer a reversal from self-directed motion to compelled motion. A live alternative is that ethical turning and eschatological driving operate in separate domains without a deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: He controls the encounter by turning away.
changed_reading.after: His chosen turn briefly performs control, but the surah answers it with a bodily transfer whose direction he cannot control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding negated pair, confirming and praying, is replaced by the affirmative pair, falsifying and turning away. Lexical truth and enacted worship are not merely absent; each is answered by an active contrary.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false supplies the direct active counter to confirming truth.
Failure to carry a charge through extends the contrast from statement into performance.
Refusal of compliance supplies the active contrary to bodily worship.
Truthful affirmation supplies the exact lexical pole rejected by كَذَّبَ.
Making word or promise real in action supplies the performative depth of the missing confirmation.
Obligatory worship supplies the embodied response whose place is taken by withdrawal.

structural_cues: 75:31 and 75:32 have matching two-verb coordination, while وَلَٰكِن marks the second pair as a corrective replacement for the first.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth/action branches and a tightly parallel contrastive grammar; I infer a two-axis antithesis, affirmation versus falsification and worship versus withdrawal. A live alternative is that the pairs accumulate four failures without strict one-to-one alignment.

changed_reading.before: He simply lacks belief and prayer, then happens to deny and leave.
changed_reading.after: He actively substitutes falsification for truthful confirmation and withdrawal for embodied worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The turn does not end in an empty elsewhere: it continues toward the subject's own people and culminates in extended, swaggering self-display. Withdrawal from one audience becomes reorientation toward a socially affirming audience.

activation_trace.role: The falsehood verdict supplies the stance carried back into the subject's social world.
Turning one's face toward something supplies the positive reorientation concealed within turning away.
Withdrawal supplies departure from the rejected audience.
Going and passing on supply continuation of the focus turn as actual movement.
A group defined by nearness and belonging supplies the receiving social destination.
Swagger through extended bearing supplies public display rather than quiet retreat.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ at 75:33 explicitly continues the focus sequence from turning away to going home and swaggering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, kin-group destination, and swagger; I infer that kin function as a confirming audience for the rejected stance. A live alternative is that going to family is only the next narrated location and carries no social reinforcement.

changed_reading.before: He withdraws from the message into an unspecified absence.
changed_reading.after: He redirects himself from the message toward his own group, where bodily swagger turns rejection into social performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus withdrawal and the repeated أَوْلَىٰ formulas share one packet root whose branches include nearness, succession, and desert. The turn away is answered by what is near, follows repeatedly, and is fittingly due to the subject.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the attempted increase of distance.
Nearness without an interval reverses the distance sought in the focus turn.
Priority and superior desert supply the sense that the approaching outcome fittingly belongs to him.
Continuous succession supplies the repeated, closing cadence of the answer to his turn.

structural_cues: 75:34-35 repeats أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ four times immediately after تَوَلَّىٰ and the swaggering departure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root and its withdrawal, nearness, succession, and desert branches; I infer a root-internal recoil in which turning away draws the due outcome near. A live alternative is that أَوْلَىٰ is a fixed threat formula whose force should not be derived from the other root branches.

changed_reading.before: تَوَلَّىٰ marks successful distancing from an unwanted claim.
changed_reading.after: The attempted distancing is lexically answered by a near, successive, and fitting consequence that adheres to the one who turns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The body records a prior passage from measured generative fluid through attachment, creation, and completed form, while the closing question joins power to giving life after death. Denial becomes a refusal of material precedent borne by the denier's own body.

activation_trace.role: Declaring the resurrection claim false supplies the proposition contradicted by embodied precedent.
Turning away supplies refusal to attend to evidence carried in the subject's own formation.
Effective capacity to bring about an act supplies the power asserted at the argument's close.
Integrity and completion of form supply the finished result of the earlier transformation.
Generative fluid from which form is measured supplies the body's low-material beginning.
A pregnancy fixed by attachment supplies the intermediate stage that holds and develops.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the causal transformation from material to organism.
Possession of living spirit supplies the state that power can restore.
Loss of power and life supplies the terminal state challenged by reanimation.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 opens the bodily argument with reassembly and exact formation; 75:37-40 closes it with an ordered creation sequence and a question about reviving the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily stages, completed form, effective power, life, and death; I infer an analogy from already accomplished formation to future restoration. A live alternative is that the sequence establishes divine power generally without making each body stage a consciously available proof for the focus subject.

changed_reading.before: He verbally rejects a remote claim about resurrection.
changed_reading.after: He rejects a claim whose operative precedent is materially inscribed in his own transition from measured fluid to completed living form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare branch of ك ذ ب describing a wild creature that runs and then stops to look behind. It remains anchored in كَذَّبَ and تَوَلَّىٰ and is reinforced by the context's staring eye and search for escape; downstream prose should present it only as an evocative lexical image, not as the grammatical sense of كَذَّبَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَ through its run-then-look-back branch and تَوَلَّىٰ through retreat.

activation_trace.role: A wild creature's short run followed by a backward look supplies the prey-like motion of an abortive escape.
Retreat supplies the overt motion to which the rare animal image attaches.
The fixed, startled gaze supplies the eventual look that interrupts flight.
Explicit flight and escape make the rare branch image contextually functional rather than free association.

changed_reading.after: His denial can evoke a creature's brief flight that must stop and look back, making the apparent escape already abortive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it moves from a deceptively patterned cloth to embodied social presentation. It remains anchored in the focus root's appearance-that-lies branch, the turning of the body, the two-faced context image, and immediate swagger; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for performed denial, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَ through deceptive appearance and تَوَلَّىٰ through bodily orientation.

activation_trace.role: A patterned surface that lies by its condition supplies denial as a worn public appearance.
Turning and presenting the face supplies bodily display of the constructed stance.
The two-faced branch supplies a contextually anchored image of discrepant public surfaces.
Swagger through extended bearing turns the deceptive surface into social performance before his people.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a proposition held or spoken.
changed_reading.after: Denial can also be carried as a social costume: a stance made visible in the body's turn and completed in swagger.

strongest_changes: The parallel at 75:31-32 makes falsification and withdrawal active replacements for truthful confirmation and worship.
The escape and death sequences reverse chosen withdrawal into an enclosed route and finally compelled conveyance to the Lord.
Love of the immediate and desire to transgress ahead recast denial as a motivated device for preserving a preferred future.
The repeated و ل ي root at 75:34-35 answers تَوَلَّىٰ with nearness, succession, and fitting desert.
The closing creation sequence makes the denier's own formed body a material counterproof to his verdict.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet turned a compact two-verb rejection into several mechanisms without forcing them into one reading: internal evasion, temporal allegiance, failed reception, social display, attempted escape, compelled return, and a root-internal reversal immediately after the focus.
remaining_uncertainties: The reception sequence in 75:16-19 addresses another hearer, so its use as an inverse psychology of the rejecter remains analogical.
Going to one's people in 75:33 may identify only the next location rather than a socially reinforcing audience.
The تَوَلَّىٰ to أَوْلَىٰ linkage is licensed by the packet's shared root but may be weaker in discourse than the repeated threat formula itself.
The two outliers preserve branch-driven images and should not be promoted into direct lexical glosses.
